let value: string | number = "a";
const before = {
  show() { console.log(this.item.toUpperCase(), this.value.toUpperCase()); },
  item: value,
  value,
};
value = 1;
before.show();

value = "before";
const ordered = {
  show() { console.log(this.item.toFixed(1), this.shorthand.toFixed(1)); },
  change: (value = 3),
  item: value,
  ...{ shorthand: value },
};
ordered.show();

let tuple: [number] | [number, number] = [1];
const growing: [[number, number], number, number, (x: number) => string] =
  [tuple = [1, 2], ...tuple, x => x.toFixed(1)];
const shrinking: [[number], number, (x: string) => string] =
  [tuple = [1], ...tuple, x => x.toUpperCase()];
console.log(growing[3](3), shrinking[2]("tuple"));
